name: [2ND FLOOR!] Build and Sell Houses!
desc:
🏡 Level up your home! Build a SECOND FLOOR, add decks, and shop brand-new items in the store! + More!

In this realistic construction simulator, build houses from the ground up!  💰 Every step you finish makes your house worth more. Can you become the richest builder in town? 👑

BUILD EVERY PART OF YOUR HOUSE:
🪵 Frame all your walls
⚡ Place a breaker box and wire lights and outlets
🚿 Get water to sinks, showers, and toilets
❄️ Add heat and AC
🏠 Choose your roofing
🧱 Add siding and sheetrock
🎨 Pick your paint colors, inside and out
🛋️ Fill every room with furniture

GROW YOUR EMPIRE:
🔓 Unlock new materials for better builds
🗺️ Expand into new districts
💵 Sell houses, earn cash, build bigger!

👍🌟 Like and favorite Build and Sell Houses for updates! 
Join our community for a reward: https://www.roblox.com/communities/33627792/Zingo-Labs#!/about

llm.loop: build a house step by step (frame, wire, plumb, HVAC, roof, siding, paint, furnish) -> sell it -> earn cash -> unlock materials and districts -> build bigger
llm.objectives: become the richest builder, build more valuable houses
llm.progression: cash, unlocked materials, districts (e.g. Beverly Hills)
llm.instructions: frame walls, place breaker box and wiring, plumbing, heat/AC, roofing, siding, sheetrock, paint, furniture; sell houses and expand
unique: detailed realistic construction steps (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) in first person
llm.thumbnails: first-person hands hammering a wood frame, sawing, using pliers on wiring inside a framed house
llm.video: 1 video on page, content not shown
llm.complexity_notes: first-person tool interactions, multi-system construction (framing, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing), furniture placement, districts
